fix_subject: Stream window functions only when volatile arguments run once per row
pr_title: a window function with a volatile argument ran it the wrong number of

labels.summary: Window value functions (FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, NTH_VALUE, and LEAD/LAG with negative offsets) took the streaming path even when their argument was volatile, so the volatile argument was evaluated the wrong number of times; the fix disables streaming for volatile arguments.
